subject: The 5 BEC red flags your AP team should memorize
text:
Ledgerly Insights

1. Reply-to mismatch
2. Lookalike domains (cobalt-freight.com vs cobaltfreight.com)
3. "Our account was closed due to an audit"
4. Numbers that fail the ABA checksum (we see routing 123456789 in real attempts)
5. Requests that arrive the week after a big invoice

Ledgerly validates every bank change against the vendor's history and flags anomalies before approval. See how: ledgerly.io/bec

Unsubscribe
label: ordinary
note: Vendor-fraud content marketing with example lookalike domains and an example routing number.
